summary: Fase 6 — Full E2E validation of MediCar Plus after visual refresh + SMS + Stripe + pricing cards changes. Backend: 43/43 pytest cases pass (24 legacy + 10 new Fase 6 for Notifications/Payments/Verify + 9 requests). Frontend: V1 loads without JS errors with new Colorful Pill visual + working SMS modal; V2 activation gate + wizard + logout + Datàfon popup + configurable company names all working; Admin panel loads with both tabs; Request-license page shows 3 pricing cards with mensual/anual toggle. ONE FUNCTIONAL BUG FOUND: empty Install ID on /request-license produces 422 because frontend sends 'CD-PENDING-0000-0000-0000' (invalid per backend regex).

critical.issue: Empty Install ID from the public form causes 422. Frontend sends the sentinel 'CD-PENDING-0000-0000-0000' when the user leaves the (opcional) field blank, but backend Pydantic validator INSTALL_ID_RE = ^CD-[A-Z0-9]{4}-[A-Z0-9]{4}-[A-Z0-9]{4}-[A-Z0-9]{4}$ rejects 'PENDING' (7 chars, not 4). Directly contradicts the spec 'Install ID és opcional (es pot enviar buit sense error)'. Users cannot submit the form without an Install ID.

integration_issues.issue: The 422 response above surfaces a red raw Pydantic error blob under the form ('[{"type":"value_error","loc":["body","install_id"]...}]'). Even after backend fix, the frontend should render a human-friendly error message, not the raw JSON validation payload.

rca of the issue: Root cause: /app/frontend/src/pages/RequestLicensePage.jsx line 39 defaults empty install_id to the literal 'CD-PENDING-0000-0000-0000'. The backend Pydantic regex ^CD-[A-Z0-9]{4}-[A-Z0-9]{4}-[A-Z0-9]{4}-[A-Z0-9]{4}$ rejects the 7-char 'PENDING' block, returning HTTP 422 with a Pydantic error blob that is then rendered raw as red text under the form. Reproduction: open /request-license, leave Install ID empty, fill required fields (empresa + email + consent), click 'Enviar sol·licitud' → red raw JSON error appears, submission blocked. Mitigation options in order of preference: (a) Backend: make install_id Optional[str] and skip validation when None/empty (also removes need for frontend sentinel); (b) Frontend: send install_id: null (or omit the field entirely from the JSON body) when the input is blank; (c) minimum fix: change the sentinel to 'CD-0000-0000-0000-0000' which passes the regex — but this creates duplicate-pending collisions across users, so option (a) is strongly preferred.
